findings.review_comment: The case-insensitive email lookup may allow attackers to trigger password resets for accounts using different case variations of registered emails. Consider normalizing email to lowercase before database lookup to prevent case-based confusion attacks. Use email.lower() on both stored and input values for consistent comparison.
